@'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd().absolute()
review = root / "review" / "round-03"
review.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
def read(name):
    return json.loads((root / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name, obj):
    (root / name).write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
answer = """有一条仍有效的审批就可以；撤销后重新判断，不要因为最初那条撤销就直接把任务终止。没有有效审批时等着。审批人要是另一名审核员，不能自己给自己批；审批有截止时间，到期那一刻就无效。

名额先按每次归档运行单独设置，两项检查各占一个，默认两个，也能改成一个来观察排队。它们可以同时运行，必须两项都通过才能提交。

中途失去审批时让已经启动的检查正常结束，保留结果，但不提交；条件恢复后我点“继续”，再重新检查资格。内容改版则旧审批和旧检查结果不能用于新版本，旧运行保留可查且不能提交；新版本可以同时开一次新运行。别让新运行覆盖还没结束的旧运行。"""
questions = [
"内容检查和索引检查分别检查哪些条件？检查失败后，是允许重试失败项，还是必须新开一次运行？",
"新运行是否必须有有效审批才能启动检查？只有一个名额时，第一项运行中审批失效，尚未启动的第二项是否要等你点击“继续”后再开始？",
"内容改版后，旧运行里尚未开始的检查直接作废、已启动的检查自然结束，同时保留全部记录且禁止提交，这样处理是否符合你的意思？"
]
doc = read("discovery.json")
doc["sources"] += [
    {"id":"U03","kind":"user","text":answer,"locator":"review/round-03/dialogue.md；实际模拟用户回答"},
    {"id":"A03","kind":"assistant","text":"\n".join(f"{i+1}. {q}" for i,q in enumerate(questions)),"locator":"review/round-03/dialogue.md；本轮实际追问"}
]
dec = {d["id"]:d for d in doc["decisions"]}
for ident, text, reqs, nodes, checks in [
    ("D04","每次归档运行独享名额；两项检查各占一个，默认两个，可设为一个；允许并发，两个检查都通过才能提交。",["R05","R04"],["processing_slots","content_check","index_check"],["per-run-resource-declaration","both-checks-required"]),
    ("D05","任一条仍有效审批即可；撤销后重新求值全部候选，没有有效审批则等待。审批者须为另一名审核员，不能自批；now 等于 deadline 时已失效。",["R03"],["approval_check"],["approval-any-declaration","approval-excludes-self","approval-expiry-exclusive"])
]:
    dec[ident].update(status="resolved",resolution={"kind":"user_answer","text":text,"source_refs":["U03"]},links={"requirements":reqs,"model_nodes":nodes,"checks":checks})
dec["D06"]["note"] = "U03 已确认审批失效时已启动检查自然结束并保留结果，手动继续重新检查资格；内容改版使旧运行不可提交且不能复用到新版本，新旧运行独立可查。仍需明确改版时旧活动如何结束，故保持 open。"
dec["D06"]["question"] = questions[2]
dec["D06"]["asked_in"] += ["A03"]
dec["D06"]["source_refs"].append("U03")
dec["D07"].update(question=questions[0],asked_in=["A03"],note="U03 已确认两项均通过才能提交；具体检查条件与失败后重试范围未答。")
dec["D08"].update(question=questions[1],asked_in=["A03"],note="U03 已确认失去审批后需手动继续并重查；新运行和未启动活动的审批门槛仍待答。")
doc["decisions"].append({"id":"D09","topic":"resources","blocking":True,"status":"open","priority":3,"source_refs":["U03"],"affects":["processing_slots"],"depends_on":["D04"],"question":"名额是在创建运行时选定，还是允许对已经开始的运行实时修改？","why":"决定运行参数是否固定及活动占用中修改容量的行为；U03 尚未明确变更时点。"})
model = read("behavior.json")
model["revision"] = "discovery-r03"
nodes = {n["id"]:n for n in model["nodes"]}
nodes["approval_check"]["rule"].update(aggregate="any",reviewer_required=True,exclude_self=True,valid_time="now < deadline",revoked_allowed=False)
nodes["approval_check"]["summary"] = "审批目标四字段匹配、审批人为另一名审核员、未撤销且未到截止时刻；任一候选有效即可。撤销后重新判断，没有有效审批则等待。"
nodes["processing_slots"].update(label="每次运行独享名额",summary="每次归档运行独享容量；默认 2，可设 1，两项检查各占 1；运行中能否改容量待 D09。",rule={"scope":"run","default_capacity":2,"activity_units":1,"parallel_allowed":True})
nodes["archive_commit"]["rule"] = {"all_checks_passed":True,"current_version_required":True,"current_approval_required":True}
nodes["approval_revoked"]["summary"] = "撤销触发审批重评；有替代有效审批时继续具备审批条件；否则等待。已启动检查完成且保留结果，不提交。"
nodes["content_changed"]["summary"] = "旧审批与旧检查结果不能用于新版本；旧运行保留且不能提交，新版本可另开独立运行，不能覆盖旧运行。旧活动如何结束待 D06。"
for ident in ["content_check","index_check"]:
    nodes[ident]["summary"] = "可与另一检查并发，各占本次运行一个名额；两项都通过才可提交。具体检查与失败后重试待 D07。"
nodes["resume_run"] = {"id":"resume_run","kind":"action","label":"点击继续并重查资格","summary":"审批条件恢复后手动继续，重查当前资格；已完成同版本检查结果保留。","binding_status":"pending","requirements":["R11"],"capture":{"in":{},"out":{}}}
nodes["run_identity"] = {"id":"run_identity","kind":"data","label":"运行身份与内容版本","summary":"每次运行独立保留活动和结果；旧新版本运行可同时查询，新运行不覆盖仍在结束的旧运行。","requirements":["R06"],"capture":{"in":{},"out":{}}}
model["nodes"] = list(nodes.values())
labels = {
"approval_archive":"任一审批有效，提交时仍需适用",
"content_archive":"内容检查通过",
"index_archive":"索引检查通过",
"slots_content":"本运行名额：内容检查占 1",
"slots_index":"本运行名额：索引检查占 1",
"revoke_approval":"撤销后重新判断全部候选",
"document_content":"本次运行的内容版本",
"edit_approval":"新版本不能沿用旧审批"
}
for edge in model["edges"]:
    if edge["id"] in labels:
        edge.update(label=labels[edge["id"]],evidence="U03；已确认规则，具体执行尚未实现")
model["edges"] += [
{"id":"resume_approval","from":"resume_run","to":"approval_check","type":"flow","label":"手动继续时重查","evidence":"U03"},
{"id":"resume_scope","from":"resume_run","to":"scope_check","type":"flow","label":"重新检查资格","evidence":"U03"},
{"id":"run_content","from":"run_identity","to":"content_check","type":"data","label":"所属运行与版本","evidence":"U03"},
{"id":"run_index","from":"run_identity","to":"index_check","type":"data","label":"所属运行与版本","evidence":"U03"},
{"id":"run_slots","from":"run_identity","to":"processing_slots","type":"data","label":"本运行独享容量","evidence":"U03"},
{"id":"edit_run","from":"content_changed","to":"run_identity","type":"data","label":"旧运行保留；新版本另开","evidence":"U03"},
{"id":"run_archive","from":"run_identity","to":"archive_commit","type":"guard","label":"旧版本运行不能提交","evidence":"U03"}
]
model["scope"]["unknowns"] = ["可执行节点尚未绑定源码，当前没有运行证据。","D06：改版时旧活动的结束方式。","D07：具体检查条件和失败后重试范围。","D08：新运行及尚未启动活动的审批门槛。","D09：容量修改是在新建前还是运行中。"]
model["questions"] = ["D07","D08","D06"]
net = doc["networks"][0]
net["actors"] = ["负责人","不同于操作人的审核员","本地归档工具"]
known = {n["id"]:n for n in net["nodes"]}
for n in model["nodes"]:
    if n["id"] not in known:
        net["nodes"].append({"id":n["id"],"label":n["label"],"kind":"data" if n["kind"]=="data" else "action","source_refs":["U03"],"model_nodes":[n["id"]]})
    elif n["id"] in ["processing_slots","approval_check","content_check","index_check","content_changed","approval_revoked"]:
        known[n["id"]]["label"] = n["label"]
        known[n["id"]]["source_refs"] = sorted(set(known[n["id"]]["source_refs"]+["U03"]))
edges = {e["id"]:e for e in net["edges"]}
for e in model["edges"]:
    if e["id"] not in edges:
        net["edges"].append({"id":e["id"],"from":e["from"],"to":e["to"],"relation":e["type"],"label":e["label"],"source_refs":["U03"]})
    elif e["id"] in labels:
        edges[e["id"]].update(label=e["label"],source_refs=sorted(set(edges[e["id"]]["source_refs"]+["U03"])))
intent = read("intent.json")
rs = {r["id"]:r for r in intent["requirements"]}
for ident, text, status in [
("R03","任一审批满足项目/操作人/资料/内容版本匹配、审核员非操作人、未撤销、now < deadline 即可；撤销后重评，无有效审批则等待。","confirmed"),
("R04","内容检查和索引检查必须全部通过才可提交；具体检查条件和失败后重试待答。","partially_defined"),
("R05","每次归档运行独享处理名额，默认 2 可设 1；每项检查占 1，可并发。运行中是否可修改容量待 D09。","partially_defined"),
("R06","内容改版后，旧审批和旧结果不能用于新版本，旧运行保留可查且不能提交，新版本可同时另开独立运行，不覆盖旧运行。旧活动结束方式待答。","partially_defined")
]:
    rs[ident].update(text=text,status=status,source_refs=sorted(set(rs[ident]["source_refs"]+["U03"])))
intent["requirements"].append({"id":"R11","text":"中途失去审批时已启动检查自然结束并保留结果，但不提交；条件恢复后手动点击继续，再检查当前资格。","source_refs":["U03"],"status":"confirmed"})
acceptance = read("acceptance.json")
acceptance["model_checks"] += [
{"id":"per-run-resource-declaration","requirement":"R05","path":["nodes","processing_slots","rule","scope"],"equals":"run"},
{"id":"both-checks-required","requirement":"R04","path":["nodes","archive_commit","rule","all_checks_passed"],"equals":True},
{"id":"approval-any-declaration","requirement":"R03","path":["nodes","approval_check","rule","aggregate"],"equals":"any"},
{"id":"approval-excludes-self","requirement":"R03","path":["nodes","approval_check","rule","exclude_self"],"equals":True},
{"id":"approval-expiry-exclusive","requirement":"R03","path":["nodes","approval_check","rule","valid_time"],"equals":"now < deadline"}
]
for name,obj in [("discovery.json",doc),("behavior.json",model),("intent.json",intent),("acceptance.json",acceptance)]:
    save(name,obj)
    save("review/round-03/"+name,obj)
(review/"dialogue.md").write_text("# 第三轮：模拟用户演练\n\n## 实际回答 U03\n\n"+answer+"\n\n## 本轮处理\n\nD04 的每运行容量及 D05 审批组合/审核员/截止时刻已明确；D06、D07、D08 的部分答案已记录，未答部分继续开放。容量变更时点单列 D09。图更新为 discovery-r03；本轮只同步必要约束，没有应用或运行验证。\n\n## 本轮追问 A03\n\n"+"\n\n".join(f"{i+1}. {q}" for i,q in enumerate(questions))+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"revision":model["revision"],"resolved":["D04","D05"],"awaiting":["D07","D08","D06"],"later_unasked":["D09"],"nodes":len(model["nodes"]),"edges":len(model["edges"])},ensure_ascii=False))
